title: 'Not seen for 10+ days' on Today and 'stopped coming' everywhere else are two different lists, and the assistant's own button messages the other one
what: The Today idea 'Not seen for 10+ days: N' and its See who list count every member with a running plan and no visit for 10 days. Everywhere else 'Stopped coming' (Messages, Your numbers, Visits > Losing the habit) uses each member's own rhythm, leaves out anyone whose plan ends within 7 days, and is empty when the register is not in use. Under the See who list the button says 'Send them a we miss you message' but asks for 'members who stopped coming', and the AI is told the usual meaning is 10 days while the code's usual meaning is the rhythm list. So the owner reads a list of names and the message can go to a different set: a member whose plan ends in 3 days and who has not come for a month is on the list but not messaged, and someone who usually trains every 3 weeks is listed after 10 days.
expected: One rule for 'not coming' across Today, the assistant, Messages and Visits, and the button under a list sends to exactly the members in that list.
fix_line: Make the idea and its button use one rule, and pass the same days to the message the list was made with

title: A member who came back after a long break is listed as 'not seen for months' on his first days back
what: When a member returns after months away and buys a new plan, the 'Not seen for 10+ days' idea and the 'no visit in N days' list count from his last visit before the break. Two days after rejoining he shows as 'no visit in 190 days' and is counted among members to chase. The 15 Nov fix for a member who joined today covers only members who never came at all.
expected: For a member whose last visit is before his current plan began, the days are counted from the plan's start, the same way as for someone who never came, so a fresh returner is not on the list.
how_often: whenever a member returns after a break
fix_line: Count days away from the later of the last visit and the start of the current plan

title: The growth answer's change in members can rise or fall with no row that explains it
what: Asking about growth shows members with a plan, then New members, Renewed, Did not renew, Plan ended and Change. A member who comes back after a long gap raises Change by one but is in no row (not new, not a renewal). A new member who has not bought a plan is in New members but does not change the count. So the rows do not add up to the change, and a rise or drop can have no reason on the card.
expected: The rows add up to the change, for example with a 'Came back after a break' row and new members counted once they have a plan, or the card says the rows are not the whole story.
how_often: any period with a returning member
fix_line: Add a came-back row and count joins with a plan, so the rows explain the change
